gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-004 identifies the same failed conversion in the main approximation theorem: Parseval makes the Fourier L2 error equal to the Frobenius norm of A-EF*, but the proof incorrectly controls it directly by the maximum-entry norm. It also recognizes that the cited theorem supplies only maximum-entry control, so the claimed dimension-free epsilon term and the dependent CUR corollary require a dimension factor or a genuine Frobenius-norm bound.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose the invalid replacement of the Frobenius norm of the coefficient residual by its maximum-entry norm in the Fourier L2 estimate. Without a one-entry restriction, the valid conversion incurs sqrt((2I_1+1)(2I_2+1)), invalidating the advertised dimension-free approximation term and its dependent corollary.

component_coverage.gold_component: The Fourier L2 error is exactly the Frobenius norm of B=A-EF*, while the proof uses an unsupported upper bound by the maximum-entry norm; only a dimension-dependent Frobenius/max-norm conversion is universally valid, affecting the main theorem and dependent CUR corollary.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-004 explicitly states the Parseval/Frobenius identity, explains that Frobenius norm is not bounded above by the maximum-entry norm, notes that the available theorem controls only the maximum-entry norm, and identifies the resulting invalid L2 bounds and necessary dimension-factor or Frobenius-bound repair.
